messages:
Sofia: Heads up — seeing a p50/p95 inversion for /v1/embed in eu-west quick summary: p50 = 150ms, p95 = 120ms. screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/abc
Ethan: yikes. quick summary or the full endpoint breakdown?
Sofia: quick summary tile under Endpoints -> /v1/embed. endpoint breakdown tile shows mismatch too, but summary is the weird one.
Priya: common cause: merged rollups across origins + tdigest merge artifacts. or a percentile extractor edge when sample_count is tiny for micro-slices.
Noah: also remember we flipped quota fallback routing last deploy; that can flood proxy-origin with many tiny fast hits.
ci-bot: deploy 6135998000 merged by @ci-bot — feature: routing.quota_fallback=true
Priya: repro I saw: proxy origin had lots of <10ms samples but very low sample_count metadata; our merge treated origin contributions poorly and underweighted the slow tail. result: p95 < p50 in merged view.
Ethan: API design question: do we expose per-origin percentiles (heavy) or return provenance metadata + sample_count and let console fetch full origins on demand?
Sofia: prefer lightweight change: include sample_count and origins array in rollup response, add a provenance param so the UI can request origins when the user opts in.
Noah: agreed. also add a "low-sample" badge for counts < 50; support needs a clear signal.
Priya: backend plan: additive schema change — add "sample_count": <int> and "origins": ["client","proxy","kvcache"]. add query flag /api/rollup?provenance=origins|merged. Also add telemetry tag fallback_policy so rollups can be filtered by rollout reason. ETA ~48h.
Ethan: small compatibility note: additive fields are safe for older clients; console change can be behind a feature toggle.
Sofia: UX ask: inline pill next to percentiles "origins: 2" that expands to per-origin counts/percentiles when provenance=origins is requested. keep default collapsed.
Noah: also log the rollout policy in request headers so we can trace which requests hit quota_fallback during rollouts.
Priya: will include fallback_policy tag in telemetry envelope. PR will cover rollup schema + provenance param + telemetry tag.
Ethan: PR #1310 opened: adds sample_count + origins, provenance query param, and fallback_policy tagging. unit tests for tdigest merge normalization included.
deploy-bot: deploy 6136004400 to staging completed by @ci-bot :white_check_mark:
Sofia: quick check on staging for the problematic time window: p95 now 160ms > p50 150ms. low-sample badge appears for micro-slices. looks promising.
Noah: scheduling prod deploy tonight 23:59 UTC (6136034340). will announce when live.
Sofia: adding a short runbook blurb + support FAQ explaining the low-sample badge and how to use the provenance toggle.
Priya: planning a recompute/backfill for affected rollups tomorrow; will surface diffs in telemetry-runbook channel.
Ethan: thanks all. once prod is live let's monitor pctl dashboards for the next 24h and watch for any other inversion windows.
